Name: Additional Chicken
Author: bansaighdear
Description:
[center][b][color=#f1c232][size=4]Do not put my work into gen ai tools. No, not even your personal local ones.[/size][/color][/b] [/center]

This adds four chickens to Marnies' animal shop:

[list]
[*]Berry colored chicken (dark pink)[/*]
[*]Petrol colored chicken (bluegreen)[/*]
[*]Gradient colored chicken ("Bicolor")[/*]
[*]Gradient colored chicken ("Sunset")[/*]
[/list]
Each one comes with corresponding chicks, eggs and mayonnaise.
Also adds a new sound for the new chickens.

Downloads.Description: Version 3; the mayonnaise now finally works
